meta.title: Traffic Light: yellow band covers above X up to and including Y
gaps: The concrete green limit X and yellow limit Y are not specified, so the threshold values cannot be entered.
The vendor-facing traffic-light color assignment cannot be asserted, including yellow for values greater than X and at or below Y and non-yellow for values above Y.
The second vendor's own supplier-portal view cannot be opened to verify its color because the catalog supports only one QA vendor session.

steps.note: Open the single-stage create screen required for configuring a traffic-light auction.
Configure the auction strategy and entire-lot awarding; threshold values are omitted because X and Y were not supplied.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Add the line item needed for vendor bids.
Complete the pricing sheet before scheduling and publishing.
Invite two vendors so bids can be submitted at the two requested value ranges.
Assert that the auction reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor bid; the value is only a placeholder because the case did not specify X or Y.
Assert that the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit a second bid for another invited vendor as the closest available way to create the above-Y comparison without a second vendor session.
Assert that the second vendor bid was accepted.
Confirm that the buyer sees both submitted vendor responses, although their traffic-light colors cannot be checked.
